topics.question: Russia-Ukraine ceasefire agreement by year end 2026

criteria_notes.manifold: Manifold asks "a ceasefire at any point in 2026", vs Polymarket's "agreement in force at year-end". Any-point-in-year is a broader window, yet Manifold sits lower — the gap is a criteria/venue difference to read, not a straight disagreement on likelihood.

criteria_notes.polymarket: The market resolves on any trade at/above $100k; the Yahoo oracle checks daily closes, so a brief intraday spike that does not close above $100k would not auto-resolve YES. Close enough to track together.

topics.question: Republicans control the US Senate after the 2026 midterms

criteria_notes.manifold: Elections are the one theme traded on every venue at once, so this is the board's widest cross-source topic. Real-money venues (Polymarket, PredictIt) are correlation-damped together; Manifold is an independent play-money crowd.

criteria_notes.polymarket: Reframed from the original "blockade or quarantine" question: no liquid blockade-specific market exists. This market resolves on an invasion / military offensive, which is a strictly higher bar than interdiction. Read the level, not the label.
criteria_notes.manifold: Manifold asks "attempt to invade by end of 2027" — an attempt is a slightly lower bar than Polymarket's "commences an offensive", so expect it to sit marginally higher.

topics.question: Will there be a new Romanian Prime Minister by end of September 2026?
Will the CLARITY Act become law in 2026?
topics.explanation: PredictIt's notably higher probability (57%) likely reflects its different trader population and market mechanics — PredictIt attracts more politically-engaged US traders who may weight the current Republican-controlled Congress and crypto-friendly administration more heavily, and its fee structure can distort prices away from true probability. The ~20pp spread is primarily genuine disagreement about legislative likelihood rather than resolution criteria mismatch, since all three markets appear to be targeting the same event (CLARITY Act enacted by end of 2026), with Polymarket and Manifold traders possibly discounting more heavily for Congressional gridlock, competing crypto bills (e.g., the stablecoin bill taking priority), and Senate passage uncertainty.

topics.question: Will a World War 3 scale global conflict occur by 2030?
topics.explanation: The two sources are measuring fundamentally different things rather than disagreeing about the same event. Polymarket's NATO-Russia military clash market asks only whether a direct military confrontation occurs by end of 2026 — a much lower threshold than a full World War 3 scenario — which inflates its probability relative to the canonical question. Manifold's market specifically conditions on nuclear involvement and treats WW3 in its maximalist sense, making it far more restrictive and explaining most of the 21-point spread. The residual difference likely reflects Polymarket's more liquid, incentivized market attracting traders who are pricing near-term escalation risk from the ongoing Ukraine war, whereas Manifold's user base may be anchoring to the base rate of global nuclear conflicts (essentially zero in the modern era).

topics.question: Will the Federal Reserve increase interest rates by the end of July 2026?
topics.explanation: The dominant driver of the 48pp spread is resolution-criteria mismatch, not genuine disagreement. Manifold covers any Fed hike across all of 2026 and PredictIt extends to September 16, 2026, giving both markets roughly 9 months of additional FOMC meetings beyond July in which a hike could occur—naturally inflating their probabilities relative to Polymarket's narrower scope. Polymarket's ~24.8% reflects only the probability of a hike at or before the late-July 2026 meeting, making its lower figure largely a mechanical consequence of the shorter window rather than a different underlying view on Fed policy trajectory.

criteria_notes.polymarket: Polymarket splits the July FOMC decision into one binary market per outcome bucket (no change / hike 25bp / hike 50bp / cut 25bp / cut 50bp) rather than a single "will they hike" market. The two hike buckets are summed here as mutually exclusive outcomes to get P(any increase) — verified live: ~24.05% + ~0.75% = ~24.8%.
